[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a method for roasting carrots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose vibrant, thick carrots.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Peel and chop 2-3 large carrots into 1-inch pieces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Toss with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper.
